question.problem: Consider the matrix given by $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 7 & -2\end{aligned}].$ Determine the value of $k$ for which the vector $b=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2 \\ k+5\end{aligned}]$ belongs to $\text{Col}(A).$
question.worked_solution:
If $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(A),$ then the equation $Ax=b$ must be consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[A\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[A\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 7 & -2 & k+5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-7{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & k+40\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & k+30\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-5 \\ {x}_{2}=2 \\ 0=k+30.\end{aligned}
$$

In order for this system to be consistent, we require $0=k+30,$ which means that $k=-30.$
